name: Fukaura (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Fukaura town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised bird with a pointed wing.
history: Municipal flag of Fukaura, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 December 1982; the emblem dates from March 1972.

features.role: Fukaura town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised bird with a pointed wing
